get.description: Firebase identity and MFA required. Only customers with an existing transactions:read staff grant are included; no new permission or global scope is granted. Hong Kong natural days include today and end at request time using [from,to). Only succeeded transaction amounts contribute to flow; posted is a compatibility count for succeeded, not Slash settlement evidence. Pending/failed counts remain separate. Missing days have null amounts. Source completeness, customer/card/merchant metadata and channel sync are unavailable. USD and USDT are never combined. Unknown or repeated query parameters are rejected. Authorization, aggregates and audit share a repeatable-read transaction; audit failure returns no data.

200.description: Consistent statistics of authorized USD transaction projections, with mandatory per-customer audit. Not channel settlement or balances.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, revoked or unverified-email identity

403.description: Inactive user, MFA absent, or no explicit transactions:read customer grants (scope_required). Accounts-only grants do not confer access.

firebaseBearer.description: Verified email, valid Firebase identity and active locally provisioned user required. Admin reads additionally require MFA and explicit DB grants.
